notes: 5 Straggler, 1 Mill, Move wood to berries after (1 build house) -- QUEUE TECHS
New villager build mosque - connect woodline and berries
Send 4 to gold, once you have 3 on gold queue 3 at TC and leave until age up
Wood worker goes to a full tree, shift queue to second full tree then woodline
Cancel mosque tech and go for scholar, build a house with wood.
Feudal finishes ~ 4:15 (go to 3640 on gold then queue to sheep) -- Build Stable + Scholar stable
Around ~7 minutes, pull out scholars to go to sacred site. Around ~7:50 the berries will run out
Can go for second blacksmith if greedy
Once sacred sites, are captured get scholars for techs
2 archery ranges / 2 black smiths / 1 stable / 1 market
Once 5 scholars in mosque - get second mosque for big feudal push or stop and go to castle
5 starting @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to chop 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then build @building_economy/mill.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@

2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ at woodline (pull the 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ from straggler when 50@resource/resource_wood.webp@)
when 5 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ you @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/sheep.webp@ until 14. Then @resource/resource_wood.webp@ again

description: All credit to Valdemar. Based on his build order (https://aoe4guides.com/builds/cuoaFU7jsHTcEfw46e27), see video below.
name: ToV Feudal Rush into Castle Push
author: Fumblez

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ starts@building_economy/mill.png@ and goes to build @building_religious/mosque.png@ (queue @technology_delhi/efficient-production.png@ first) / 5 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@
2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped straggler @resource/resource_wood.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
Pull @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ at 3770G in Gold Vein onto @resource/resource_wood.png@  -> Queue @unit_delhi/scholar.png@

Rally @landmark_delhi/tower-of-victory.webp@@unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ back to @resource/resource_food.png@. Build @building_technology/blacksmith.png@. Then either build a second @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ immediately if space or   @building_military/archery-range.png@ if under pressure
QUEUE MOSQUE TECHS. Prioritize @technology_delhi/sanctity.webp@, then @technology_delhi/all-seeing-eye.png@, then @technology_religious/piety.png@

@unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ split should be heavier on @resource/resource_wood.png@ initially to get down @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ + prod buildings (make @building_military/stable.png@ or @building_military/barracks.png@ + @building_military/archery-range.png@). Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in prod buildings to spam units
Now balance economy approx 50/50 to build @resource/resource_food.webp@+@resource/resource_wood.png@heavy units and @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@around @resource/sacred_sites.png@.

Remove @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ from prod. buildings and send to @resource/sacred_sites.png@. It's okay to split units for sites so long as you aren't losing too many. Make @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @resource/sacred_sites.png@ @resource/resource_gold.png@
At this point, producing out of ~3 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and 2 @building_military/barracks.png@ (w/ 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ garrisoned)

CASTLE TIMING - Use @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.webp@ (not if opponent is in castle): build 3-4 @building_military/barracks.png@ (total with scholars) and mass@unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.png@. Send age up vills to @resource/resource_stone.png@and @building_defensive/keep.png@-drop opponents base when pushing. Go siege, if necessary, and, if you can't push, build economy with @building_defensive/keep.png@. Valdemar drops his @landmark_delhi/compound-of-the-defender.png@ at around 15:50 (this changes based on game state) using 12 villagers from wood. Only ever go @landmark_delhi/house-of-learning.png@ if you are very late/the last person to reach castle (maybe 5% of games)
Of course, scout opponent and build units that counter his. This is just a guide.
SCHOLARS - Shoot for 10-12 @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ in castle and ~20 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ in imperial to get techs in a reasonable amount of time.

2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@  build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ @technology_economy/forestry.png@
Make 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ from @landmark_delhi/dome-of-the-faith.png@ and garrison it inside of @building_military/stable.png@.
Send at least 1 or 2  @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.webp@ to each enemy, don't attack always the same.
If one of them builds @building_defensive/outpost.png@, you can destroy it with (at least) 9 @unit_delhi/ghazi-raider-2.png@ after @technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ is researched.
and @technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@ on the second one (order matters!)
@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ only role are to scare @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ away and to build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@, but you can eventually gather a decent mass of them.
Move both @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ out to capture @resource/sacred_sites.png@ just as @technology_delhi/sanctity.png@ is about to be completed.

Don't fight too hard for @resource/sacred_sites.png@. Use them as a distraction, forcing the enemies to move out of their base and creating more opportunitites to raid. Obviously the extra @resource/resource_gold.png@ is nice.
If @resource/sacred_sites.png@ are contested frequently, put some @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to gather @resource/resource_gold.png@
Build @building_defensive/palisade-wall.webp@ with @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ to defend your base or to block @resource/relics.png@.
If you are playing in a closed map, you can even wall your opponents inside of their bases.
If you are getting raided by cavalry, build @building_military/barracks.webp@ and train @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@ to defend and wall your base.
Make @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ to steal @resource/deer.png@ from the opponent's side of the map, securing food and delaying the farm transition.
<- Reallocate villagers to something similar to this.
Attack quickly and frequently to prevent the opponents from aging up to @age/age_4.webp@.
Build 1 @building_military/siege-workshop.png@ and garrison 1 @unit_delhi/scholar.png@ inside. That will be enough until late @age/age_4.png@.
Depending on how defensive the enemies are playing:
@building_defensive/keep.webp@ in your base to defend against a counterattack while you get upgrades.
@building_defensive/keep.png@ to protect key resources in the middle of the map.
Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.png@ with infantry to protect your base.
3 @building_defensive/keep.png@ is a good amount to stop gathering @resource/resource_stone.png@.
<- Ideal economy (for now) should look like this
@landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.webp@ for faster tempo (faster late game upgrades) and better food economy. Allows you to liberate population space for a bigger army.
@landmark_delhi/palace-of-the-sultan.png@ good when constantly fighting/trading units with the opponents.
Make @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ up to 20, but don't build more @building_religious/mosque.png@.
Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside @landmark_delhi/hisar-academy.png@/@building_technology/madrasa.png@ (including the 3 that spawn outside of it).
After unit upgrades and economic technologies are completed: Garrison @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ inside military buildings.
Build @building_defensive/stone-wall.webp@ with your units as you push into the opponent's side of the map to protect reinforcements and control resources.

description:
Best for open maps like Dry Arabia or High View.

Gameplan:
- get safely to 2TC (react to initial push)
- take sacred sites
- (optional) wall sacred sites (e.g. wall far ones, keep army in the middle)
- mass units
- "naturally" age up with compound of the defender
- build keeps EVERYWHERE

Do not use scholars to fight until past age III!

notes: 2 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ to chopped @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@, then 1 new @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ to build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ at woodline (pull the 2 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.png@ from straggler when 50@resource/resource_wood.png@)
Queue @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ in @building_religious/mosque.webp@ - CANcele o upgrade que estiver e priorize o padre, depois refaça a lista

When 12 @unit_worker/villager-delhi.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ start rallying to @resource/resource_food.png@ (balance eco around your unit comp. More ghazi = more on food and vice versa with archers.)
Send both @unit_delhi/scholar.webp@ to @resource/sacred_sites.png@ at 7 mins. Only wall @resource/sacred_sites.png@ that are furthest away (and therefore toughest to defend)
@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@finishes and you should have an upgrade advantage

You should try to have around 12 ghazi + 12 archers at min 10. Macroing with delhi just involves taking pocket resources and balancing around production. Then when you have sacred sites, you produce 5 scholars in total and then spend all your gold income in the market to boost your economy.
